race.description: Lawrence & Hanson Burleigh Waters Mdn Plate
race.comment: MISSION WISE (1) can get off the mark this time, with his Ballina third behind reading well for this 1540m assignment and the distance record showing a placing from his only previous attempt around this trip. Coming back in distance looks manageable in a maiden where few have a stronger exposed platform. OAKFIELD GALAXY (2) looks one of the main dangers despite the long maiden record, as his last-start defeat is softened by racing wide throughout and he has placed at both this track and on synthetic. BEAT THE DRUM (3) is still raw after two unplaced runs, yet he is third-up, gets a 3kg claim and had some excuses last time. MY HOUSE (4) is second-up for a home stable. Chance to improve into the minor money if the new trip draws a better finish out of him. ELEMISS (6) was an eye-catcher two back. Keeping safe for a minor spot.
